children.name: Desktop
Login - Page Rendering
Password field masks its input
Login page is reachable by direct URL
Login page renders all expected elements
Login - Desktop Modal
Deep link /account/login renders the form as a modal over the lobby
Top-nav Login button opens the modal in place, without navigation
Submitting valid credentials in the modal signs the user in
Login - Valid Credentials
User can log in with a valid username
User can log in with a valid email
User lands on home after a successful login
Login honours the "next" query param redirect
Login - Invalid Credentials
Login is rejected with an invalid password
Login is rejected for an unknown username
Login is rejected with an empty username
Login is rejected with an empty password
Login is rejected with both fields empty
Error clears on retry with valid credentials
Login - Navigation
Forgot password link navigates to password reset
Unauthenticated user sees the Join Now button on home
Contests - Desktop Pick Slip
Prompt advances on pick select and reverts on remove
Empty slip shows the Let's Start onboarding panel
Contests - Slip validation
Two picks from the same team keep the slip locked
A single pick never unlocks the slip
Selection is capped at 9 picks
Entry amount presets and typed values are clamped to balance, cap and cents
Payout figures match the payout-structure API for All In and Insured
Login - Logout Flow
Logged-in user can log out
User can log in again after logging out
Contests - Server-side submission guards
A slip naming the same player twice is rejected by the server
Double-clicking Place creates exactly one entry
Contests - Logged-out submit
Placing picks logged out redirects to signup and the slip survives login
Contests - Enter Contest
Five-pick contest is submitted successfully
Picks Submitted screen exposes the description CTA and opens the editor
Placed contest appears in the My Entries list
Submitting a contest raises the entry amount and max payout totals
Placing an entry debits the wallet by the entry amount and cancelling refunds it
Data verification - active entries
Active entry cards render the entries-paged API data
Data verification - history entries
History cards and summary render the history API data
Data verification - picks grid
Player cards render the offering API data
Switching stat tabs renders that stat's API line on every card
Stats selector tabs equal the API stat names for the default league
League selector tabs correspond to leagues present in the API
Match selector lists every API match for the default league
Data verification - player detail modal
Expert-opinion modal renders the API's player data
Data verification - feed search
Searching an API player's full name shows only matching cards
Searching a team abbreviation shows that team's players
Search auto-switches the stat tab to one the searched player offers
No-result, minimum-length and clear behaviours
My Entries - Active and History
Active tab shows the Entry Amount and Max Payout stats
Active tab shows at most one page of entry cards, or the no-data state
Entry card expands and collapses via its header button
User can switch between the Active and History tabs
Cancel Entry countdown stays within the 5-minute window
History summary stats match the API for the 6 Months range
Switching from 6 Months to 7 Days never increases the history count
First history card shows the amount, result and pick count from the API
Pagination advances through every history page
Switching the time range from the last page settles on data or the empty state
My Entries - entry card
Active card shows the entry amount, payout and Insured/All In multiplier
Collapsed active card shows the pick-badge preview; expanding hides it
History cards never render the pick-badge preview
Dedicated chevron toggle expands and collapses the card
History entry surfaces a Won / Lost / Cancelled result pill
Live entries surface a Live indicator
Tailers pill reads "<n> tailers | $<reward>" when an entry has tailers
Share button opens the share-slip modal for shareable entries
View Leaderboard opens the contest-group leaderboard modal
My Entries - cancel entry
Fresh entry shows a live cancel countdown and confirming Cancel Entry removes it everywhere
Confirming cancel twice fires the cancel request only once (double-submit guard)
My Entries - History Leaderboard FAQ
View Leaderboard on a history card opens the leaderboard modal with a working FAQ link
Home - Feed Search
Gibberish query shows the empty state, clearing restores the grid
A common letter narrows the grid without emptying it
Menu - Desktop Account Dropdown
Dropdown shows the Deposit CTA and the Account/Rewards/Support groups
Menu items link to the same destinations as the mobile Account Center
Navigating via a menu item closes the dropdown and routes
User Limits - Limit Exceeded Modal
Exceeding the daily entry limit shows the Limit Exceeded modal and Reset Limits clears it
Footer - age badge
Home footer shows the 18+ age badge and no 21+ anywhere
Legal - policy documents
/terms renders the Terms Of Service PDF
/privacy-policy renders the Privacy Policy PDF
/rules renders the Game Rules PDF
/terms/packs renders the Packs Terms PDF
/responsible-gaming renders the Responsible Play PDF
Signup Class Action Waiver link opens the Terms document at #class-action

Legal - footer links

Packs - access control
Unauthenticated visit to /packs redirects to login with a next param
Staff user sees the Packs entry and can open the lobby
Packs - lobby
Lobby renders the Open a Pack catalog with at least one pack tile
Pack tiles link to a /packs/pack/<id> detail route

A 'See all' link opens a subcategory listing

Packs - opening iframe
Buy launches the Repackz opening iframe with a close bar

Packs - pack detail
Detail page shows the pack name, Buy CTA and a back link

View Odds opens the Pack Odds modal (when the pack has odds)
Quantity stepper is bounded at 1 and scales the Buy price
Unknown pack id shows the not-found message
Rewards - Partner Rewards
Partner Rewards is the default tab, alongside a Promotions tab
Partner offer cards render, or the empty state when none are available
Claimed offers are non-interactive and sorted below unclaimed offers
An available offer exposes an enabled CTA
Switching to the Promotions sub-tab routes to /rewards/promotions
Settings - Player Limits
My Settings no longer renders the Player Limits controls
Settings - Referrals
Page shows the $20 referral bonus pitch and the personal signup link
Referral table matches GET /api/v1/referrals/
Without referrals the table is not rendered
Settings - Edit Profile
Display name is read-only and shows the approved public name
Display name rules: length, charset, uniqueness and cooldown are enforced server-side
Bio rejects links and formatting before anything is sent
Bio save goes to moderation; clearing it auto-approves
Experience level is shown read-only and only a derived boolean is public
Language switcher posts the preference and translates the page
Settings - My Settings
My Settings shows the username, email and name from the user API

Deep link /account/signup renders the form as a modal over the lobby
Top-nav Join Now opens the modal in place, without navigation
"Already have an account?" switches to the login modal

Signup - Desktop Field Validation
Username must be 3+ letters that nobody owns yet
Password needs 8+ characters with lower, upper and digit

Date of birth year select stops 18 years ago
Sign Up stays disabled until the phone is verified and both consents are ticked
